name: 49032 · Centreville, MI
findings: ZIP 49032 (Centreville) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49032 (Centreville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49032 (Centreville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.4 times the typical level).
